name: Zechariah
overview: Zechariah was a male member of the tribe of Levi, specifically identified as the fourth-born son of Hosah. His role or additional notes are not detailed beyond this familial and tribal designation. This places him within the Levitical lineage, which held significant religious responsibilities in Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Zechariah means 'y-h-v-h remembers,' reflecting a theologically rich meaning tied to God's faithfulness. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 26:11 and was not given directly by God but carries a meaningful reminder of divine remembrance.
familyAndRelationships: Zechariah is explicitly identified as the son of Hosah, establishing his immediate paternal relationship. Scripture does not record any further family relationships beyond this connection and his position as the fourth-born son.
scriptureSignificance: Zechariah's significance lies primarily in his identification within the Levitical genealogy, marking him as part of the priestly tribe entrusted with temple duties and worship. His mention as the fourth-born son of Hosah situates him within the historical and spiritual heritage of Israel's religious leadership. While the biblical record does not elaborate on his personal actions, his inclusion in the genealogical records underscores the importance of preserving the lineage of those who served God faithfully.
